codes.TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED: tool name invalid or not in HOMEPILOT_MIRROR_ALLOWED_TOOLS
codes.CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: the operation is switched off on the node
codes.TOOL_FAILED: the tool returned an error or no result
codes.NODE_OFFLINE: the HomePilot node is not connected
codes.RESOURCE_REJECTED: an input image was refused (type, size, checksum)
codes.IMAGE_EDIT_FAILED: the image edit did not produce an image
codes.JOB_TIMEOUT: the job did not finish in time
codes.NODE_RESTARTED: the node restarted while the job was running
